blends.name: Egg Bandits - Magor Egg Hunt
blends.desc:
The gang is hanging out and aliens are stealing eggs in the background. (Are you one of the aliens mining in magor? Are you stealing the eggs?)

Stickum is required for this blend and can be [purchased here](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/timberlandia/drops/171582).
### Magor Egg Hunt
Magor Egg Hunt is a collaborative Alien Worlds mining event featuring the timberlandia & petsofclarks WAX collections. For a limited time, mine on Magor 22:1 while holding a Hoarding Pass. Event NFT rewards are distributed hourly to participants at random and weighted by qualifying mining activity. Use NFT rewards to complete blends of pets, woodland creatures, and full collaborative scenes.
#### Hoarding Pass
https://neftyblocks.com/collection/myzicklearmy/drops/144093

#### Mining Info
https://discord.gg/3pmpNdNGcj

### Collaborators
#### Timberlandia
Kylin VanderMeer is the artist and goof behind Timberlandia. Timberlandia is a collection of artwork around cute and fun forest creatures inspired by the Canadian North and the most delicious thing that comes from there: Maple Syrup. They're also the creator of Kylin Creates, an eclectic collection of art created digitally, in ink, and with watercolour, covering everything from bizarre monsters to lovely flowers and pretty birds.

Collections: [timberlandia](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/timberlandia), [kylincreates](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/kylincreates)
Social: https://twitter.com/kylincreations

#### Pets of Clark
Eneida Clark is the mind behind the Pets of Clark collection, blending various genres featuring her family’s pets and the Art of Clark collection, an eccentric appreciation of old dolls, folklore, and things that go bump in the night.

Collections: [petsofclarks](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/petsofclarks), [artsofclarks](https://neftyblocks.com/collection/artsofclarks)
Social: https://twitter.com/ArtsOfClarkE
